name: EMIEW
summary: Excellent Mobility and Interactive Existence as Workmate — a humanoid-torso robot on a fast two-wheeled base built by Hitachi as a reception and guidance 'workmate'. EMIEW 2 (2007) and EMIEW 3 (2016) added speech, obstacle avoidance and cloud-connected recovery so it could work in real offices and stations.
notable: Wheeled service humanoid matching ASIMO's 6 km/h
